_README: Hand-curated funding overrides for the landscape scatter (X axis). The pipeline only knows what the companies' own pages stated (usually nothing), so fill usd_m with a SOURCED total-funding-raised figure in USD millions and put the source in basis. Leave usd_m null to fall back to the pipeline value / mark 'not disclosed'. Keys must match the company name exactly. Proteins.1's own point is set in reports/build_frontend_page.py (SELF).
